name: DoubleUp2
summary: This EA uses CCI and MACD indicators to generate buy/sell signals when both exceed a threshold level (±230). It employs a Martingale position sizing scheme that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, and closes profitable positions after a minimum price distance is achieved.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI和MACD指标在两者均超过±230阈值时生成买卖信号。它采用马丁格尔仓位管理方案，在每次亏损后加倍手数，并在达到最小价格距离后关闭盈利仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI和MACD两个动量指标的组合信号，当两者同时超过230阈值时触发交易。入场条件为CCI>230且MACD>230时卖出，CCI<-230且MACD<-230时买入，这是一种极端超买超卖的逆势策略。出场条件分两种：一是在开反向仓位时关闭反向持仓（closeAll函数），二是当持仓盈利且价格偏离开仓价超过120点时平仓（close函数）。仓位管理采用典型的马丁格尔策略，通过m_pos计数器追踪连续亏损次数，新仓位手数为基础手数乘以2的m_pos次方，即每次亏损后手数翻倍。资金管理方面，基础手数根据账户余额动态计算（余额/50001），最低0.1手，但缺乏止损设置，所有交易的止损和止盈均为0，这意味着亏损只能通过反向信号或马丁格尔机制来处理。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on combined signals from CCI and MACD momentum indicators, triggering trades when both exceed the 230 threshold. Entry conditions are: sell when CCI>230 and MACD>230, buy when CCI<-230 and MACD<-230, which is essentially a counter-trend approach trading against extreme momentum readings. Exit conditions are twofold: first, opposing positions are closed when a reverse signal occurs (via closeAll function), and second, profitable positions are closed when price deviation from entry exceeds 120 points (via close function). Position sizing employs a classic Martingale scheme using the m_pos counter to track consecutive losses, with new position lots calculated as base lot multiplied by 2 raised to the power of m_pos, effectively doubling the lot size after each loss. Money management dynamically calculates the base lot from account balance (balance/50001) with a minimum of 0.1 lots, but critically lacks stop-loss settings as all trades use 0 for both SL and TP, meaning losses can only be addressed through reverse signals or the Martingale mechanism.
pros: 双指标确认减少假信号，CCI和MACD同时超阈值才入场
动态手数计算与账户余额挂钩，有一定资金管理意识
反向信号时先平掉对向持仓，避免对冲占用保证金
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation reduces false signals by requiring both CCI and MACD to exceed thresholds simultaneously
Dynamic lot sizing linked to account balance shows some money management awareness
Closes opposing positions before opening new ones, avoiding hedge margin usage
cons: 马丁格尔仓位翻倍策略在连续亏损时会导致手数指数级增长，极端行情下可能爆仓
所有交易无止损设置（SL=0, TP=0），风险完全敞口
close()函数使用OrdersTotal()遍历但用m_position.SelectByIndex()选择，这是严重的逻辑错误，OrdersTotal返回挂单数而非持仓数
m_pos计数器在close()中递增逻辑混乱，盈利时m_pos+=2而非归零，与马丁格尔理论矛盾
无新K线检查，每个tick都会尝试开仓，可能导致重复交易
cons_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses, risking account blowup in extreme markets
All trades have no stop-loss (SL=0, TP=0), leaving risk completely exposed
The close() function uses OrdersTotal() for iteration but m_position.SelectByIndex() for selection, which is a serious logic error since OrdersTotal returns pending orders count not positions count
The m_pos counter logic in close() is confused — incrementing by 2 on profit instead of resetting, contradicting Martingale theory
No new bar check means the EA attempts to trade on every tick, potentially causing duplicate entries
improvements: 添加止损保护，至少设置基于ATR或固定点数的止损，避免单笔亏损无限扩大
修复close()函数中OrdersTotal与SelectByIndex的逻辑错误，应使用PositionsTotal代替OrdersTotal
添加最大马丁格尔层数限制和新K线检查，防止手数无限增长和重复开仓
improvements_en: Add stop-loss protection using ATR-based or fixed pip stops to prevent unlimited single-trade losses
Fix the critical bug in close() where OrdersTotal() should be PositionsTotal() to correctly iterate positions instead of pending orders
Add maximum Martingale level limits and new bar checks to prevent unlimited lot growth and duplicate entries per tick

risk_points: 马丁格尔加倍策略无层数上限，连续亏损可导致手数指数级增长直至爆仓
所有仓位无止损保护，极端行情下单笔亏损无上限
close()函数存在严重逻辑Bug，使用OrdersTotal遍历持仓会导致平仓功能失效
无新K线检查，每tick可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling has no level cap, consecutive losses cause exponential lot growth risking account liquidation
No stop-loss on any position means unlimited single-trade loss in extreme market conditions
Critical bug in close() using OrdersTotal() instead of PositionsTotal() causes the close-profit function to fail entirely
No new bar check allows potential duplicate trade entries on every tick
